desc: 3 ½” Chamber Over and Under. The Hunter Mag II features a solid frame for durability and strength, sealed actions to keep dirt out, self-adjusting locking lugs, top tang barrel selector and safety, and steel mono-block barrel construction and injection molded stock and forearm for increased durability. Comes with 5 interchangeable Beretta®/Benelli® Mobil style choke tubes (SK, IC, M, IM, F), choke box and choke wrench. Rubber recoil pad included
